# CleanYourMail **La tua casella, senza il rumore.** Una skill locale e agent-native che legge solo le intestazioni delle email, trova newsletter, promozioni, notifiche social, contatti a freddo e spam, li archivia in cartelle o etichette e invia richieste di disiscrizione — senza leggere il corpo dei messaggi e senza eliminare nulla in modo permanente. La maggior parte dei pulitori di casella chiede la password, legge le email e cancella le prove. CleanYourMail gira in locale, legge solo le intestazioni e registra ogni spostamento, così puoi annullarlo. [Sito](https://cleanyourmail.org/) · [SKILL.md](SKILL.md) · [PROMPT.md](PROMPT.md) · [Sicurezza](docs/SAFETY.md) ## Inizia qui | Hai | Inizia da | |---|---| | Una casella e un agente | L’avvio rapido con agente, qui sotto. | | Un terminale e nessun agente | L’avvio rapido con la CLI, qui sotto. | | Vuoi vederlo prima | [Il sito](https://cleanyourmail.org/). | | Ti servono le regole di sicurezza | [docs/SAFETY.md](docs/SAFETY.md). | ## Perché CleanYourMail - **Privato per costruzione.** La CLI gira in locale. Legge solo intestazioni, salva metadati e non ha telemetria né API di terze parti. L’unica eccezione è lo strumento opzionale per le segnalazioni `scripts/feedback.py`, che invia un contenuto rivisto solo quando viene eseguito con `--yes`. - **Reversibile per impostazione predefinita.** Ogni spostamento viene registrato con COPYUID e Message-ID. Un comando lo ripristina. - **Agent-native, non solo per agenti.** La CLI è il prodotto. `SKILL.md` e `PROMPT.md` insegnano a qualsiasi agente a usarla in sicurezza. [Confronta con i pulitori ospitati →](https://cleanyourmail.org/#why) ## Cosa fa - **Legge solo le intestazioni.** Mittente, oggetto, data, dimensione, flag e intestazioni `List-Unsubscribe`. Nessun corpo, nessun allegato, nessun download completo della casella. - **Classifica** le email in newsletter, promozione, social, notifica, contatto a freddo, spam, transazionale e personale. - **Protegge** banche, codici di sicurezza, fatture, viaggi, salute, governo, legale, personale, preferiti, risposti e recenti. Nulla cambia durante `scan`, `report` o `plan`. - **Archivia in modo reversibile.** Sposta in cartelle/etichette, Junk o Trash; l’archivio Gmail rimuove l’etichetta Inbox. Microsoft 365 richiede il consenso dell’amministratore del tenant; Outlook.com personale richiede un publisher verificato. Il tenant può disabilitare SMTP AUTH. | | Yahoo | Password per app | Account Security → Generate app password. | | iCloud | Password specifica per app | Apple richiede 2FA. | | Fastmail | Password per app | Password IMAP/SMTP con permessi; export Sieve. | | Proton | Proton Mail Bridge | Bridge deve essere attivo; usa host, porta e password IMAP/SMTP. | | IMAP personalizzato | Login o XOAUTH2 | Configura host/porta/TLS. I flag special-use sono usati per Trash/Junk/Archive. | Più dettagli: [docs/PROVIDERS.md](docs/PROVIDERS.md). ## Comandi comuni | Comando | Cosa fa | Modifica la posta? | |---|---|---| | `init` | Scrive un `cleanyourmail.toml` iniziale. | No | | `connect` | Accede a Outlook con Microsoft (device code). | No | | `secret` | Salva una password per app in locale senza mostrarla. | No | | `validate` | Controlla il TOML senza connettersi. | No | | `doctor` | Accede, elenca capacità e cartelle speciali. | No | | `folders` | Elenca o crea cartelle di posta. | No | | `scan` | Salva le intestazioni e classifica i messaggi. | No | | `report` | Mostra mittenti, categorie, liste vecchie e posta protetta. | No | | `plan` | Scrive `plan.json` con spostamenti e obiettivi di disiscrizione. | No | | `apply` | Esegue gli spostamenti; `--action unsubscribe` per le disiscrizioni. | Sposta/archivia | | `unsubscribe` | Invia solo richieste automatiche di disiscrizione. | Invia richieste | | `unsubs` | Mostra la cronologia delle disiscrizioni. | No | | `journal` | Mostra esecuzioni e voci del journal. | No | | `undo` | Ripristina spostamenti/archivi di un’esecuzione. | Sposta/archivia | | `rules` | Esporta XML filtri Gmail o Sieve. | No | Usa `--config path.toml` per una configurazione non predefinita e `--json` per output leggibile da macchina. Usa `report --redact --no-subjects` prima di condividere uno schermo. ## Come decide | Categoria | Destinazione predefinita | Azione | |---|---|---| | newsletter | `CleanYourMail/Newsletters` | archivia + disiscrivi se automatico | | promozione | `CleanYourMail/Promotions` | archivia + disiscrivi se automatico | | social | `CleanYourMail/Social` | archivia | | notifica | `CleanYourMail/Notifications` | archivia | | contatto a freddo | `CleanYourMail/Cold` | archivia | | spam | `Junk` (o `Spam`) | sposta in Junk; lo spam già in Junk può andare in Trash | | transazionale | resta | mai spostato automaticamente | | personale | resta | mai spostato automaticamente | La classificazione usa `List-Unsubscribe`, `List-ID`, `Precedence`, `Auto-Submitted`, `Authentication-Results`, header di campagna, domini/parti locali del mittente e il testo dell’oggetto in inglese e spagnolo. È volutamente conservativa: un falso “tieni” costa meno di un falso spostamento. Il planner salta anche i messaggi più recenti di `policy.min_age_days` (30 di default), quelli preferiti o già risposti, gli indirizzi/domini protetti, la posta transazionale/personale e tutto ciò che supera i limiti per gruppo o per esecuzione. ## Gmail, etichette e modalità archivio Gmail ha etichette, non cartelle. `CleanYourMail/Newsletters` è un’etichetta annidata. La modalità archivio rimuove l’etichetta `\Inbox` con `X-GM-LABELS`; il messaggio resta in All Mail. L’undo lo trova tramite `X-GM-MSGID` (o Message-ID) e riaggiunge `\Inbox`. Sugli altri provider, la modalità archivio sposta i messaggi nella cartella `\Archive` o `\All` del server. Se il server non ne annuncia nessuna, la CLI rifiuta invece di indovinare. ## Regole lato server ```bash python tools/mail.py rules --format gmail --out gmail-filters.xml python tools/mail.py rules --format sieve --out cleanyourmail.sieve ``` I filtri riguardano **solo le nuove email**. Non spostano i messaggi esistenti. Gmail: crea prima le etichette, poi importa l’XML in Settings → Filters → Import. Sieve: rivedi lo script e caricalo dall’interfaccia del provider. L’export esclude mittenti protetti, transazionali, personali e spam. ## Test ```bash python -m unittest discover -s tests -v ``` La suite usa un server IMAP falso in-process; non serve una casella reale né la rete. Copre classificazione, parsing, pianificazione, store/journal, configurazione, sicurezza URL, archivio/undo Gmail, rifiuti senza MOVE e senza UIDPLUS, flussi CLI e il documento della skill. ## Documentazione - [SKILL.md](SKILL.md) — procedura dell’agente e regole di sicurezza. - [PROMPT.md](PROMPT.md) / [PROMPT.es.md](PROMPT.es.md) — prompt brevi per agenti senza skill. - [docs/SAFETY.md](docs/SAFETY.md) — posta protetta, undo, politica di eliminazione, prompt injection. - [docs/PROVIDERS.md](docs/PROVIDERS.md) — Gmail, Microsoft, Yahoo, iCloud, Fastmail, Proton, custom. - [docs/UNSUBSCRIBE.md](docs/UNSUBSCRIBE.md) — RFC 8058, mailto, link manuali, protezione SSRF. - [docs/FOLDERS.md](docs/FOLDERS.md) — tassonomia, etichette Gmail, modalità archivio, regole. - [docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md](docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md) — auth, IMAP, cartelle, limiti, undo. - [docs/FAQ.md](docs/FAQ.md) — le domande più frequenti. - [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) — sviluppo, test e invarianti di sicurezza. - [Sito](https://github.com/jparedesDS/cleanyourmail-web) — la landing statica. ## Contribuire Leggi [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) e [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md). # CleanYourMail **あなたの受信箱を、ノイズなしで。** メールのヘッダーだけを読む、ローカルで動くエージェント向け スキルです。ニュースレター、プロモーション、SNS 通知、コールドメール、スパムを見つけ、フォルダや ラベルに整理し、安全に配信停止します。本文は読まず、完全削除は行いません。 ほとんどの受信箱クリーナーはパスワードを求め、メールを読み、証拠を消します。CleanYourMail は ローカルで動き、ヘッダーだけを読み、すべての移動を記録するので、元に戻せます。 [ウェブサイト](https://cleanyourmail.org/) · [SKILL.md](SKILL.md) · [PROMPT.md](PROMPT.md) · [安全性](docs/SAFETY.md) ## ここから始める | あなたの環境 | 開始方法 | |---|---| | メールボックスとコーディングエージェント | 下の「エージェントでのクイックスタート」へ。 | | ターミナルだけでエージェントなし | 下の「CLI でのクイックスタート」へ。 | | まず見てみたい | [ウェブサイト](https://cleanyourmail.org/)。 | | 安全ルールが必要 | [docs/SAFETY.md](docs/SAFETY.md)。 | ## CleanYourMail を選ぶ理由 - **設計からプライベート。** CLI はローカルで動きます。ヘッダーだけを読み、メタデータを保存し、 テレメトリやサードパーティ API はありません。唯一の例外は、オプションのフィードバック補助 ツール `scripts/feedback.py` です。`--yes` を付けて実行したときにだけ、レビュー済みの ペイロードを送信します。 - **デフォルトで元に戻せる。** すべての移動は COPYUID と Message-ID で記録されます。1 つの コマンドで復元できます。 - **エージェント専用ではなく、エージェントネイティブ。** CLI が製品です。`SKILL.md` と `PROMPT.md` が、どのコーディングエージェントでも安全に使えるようにします。 [ホスト型クリーナーとの比較 →](https://cleanyourmail.org/#why) ## できること - **ヘッダーだけをスキャン。** 送信者、件名、日付、サイズ、フラグ、`List-Unsubscribe` ヘッダー。本文、添付ファイル、メールボックス全体のダウンロードはありません。 - **分類**：ニュースレター、プロモーション、ソーシャル、通知、コールドメール、スパム、 トランザクション、パーソナル。 - **保護**：銀行、セキュリティコード、請求書、旅行、医療、行政、法務、個人、スター付き、返信済み、 最近のメール。保護されたメッセージは表示されますが、自動で移動・配信停止されることはありません。 - **実行前に計画。** 正確な UID、移動先、配信停止対象を含むレビュー可能な `plan.json` を書き出します。 `scan`、`report`、`plan` の間は何も変更されません。 - **元に戻せる整理。** フォルダ/ラベル、Junk、Trash に移動します。Gmail のアーカイブは Inbox ラベルを外します。すべての移動は COPYUID と Message-ID で記録され、`undo` で復元できます。 - **安全な配信停止。** RFC 8058 のワンクリック POST、`mailto:`、または手動リンク。本文内リンク、 リダイレクト、Cookie、ローカル/プライベート宛先は使いません。 - **ルールのエクスポート**：Gmail フィルターと Sieve。レビュー後に新しいメールを自動整理できます。 - **完全削除はしません。** Trash を空にせず、「完全に削除」もなく、Trash への一括 EXPUNGE も 行いません。 ## できないこと - メッセージ本文や添付ファイルは読みません。 - 通常のメール送信、返信、転送、パスワード/2FA の変更はしません。 - Google OAuth は使いません（Gmail はアプリパスワードを使用）。Microsoft は組み込みの device code サインインを使い、refresh token のみをローカルに保存します。 - サーバー側フィルターのアップロードはしません。レビュー用にエクスポートするだけです。 - 配信停止リクエストが送信者を止めることを保証しません。 - Gmail のラベルを実際のフォルダにはしません。 - 会社/学校のポリシー、IMAP 制限、Proton Bridge の要件を回避しません。 ## エージェントでのクイックスタート 1. リポジトリをクローンし、フォルダをエージェントで開きます。 2. [`PROMPT.md`](PROMPT.md) を貼り付け、プロバイダーとメールアドレスを入力します。 3. `apply` を許可する前に `plan.json` を確認します。 4. undo コマンドを保存します。 ```bash git clone https://github.com/jparedesDS/cleanyourmail.git cd cleanyourmail ``` エージェントは [`SKILL.md`](SKILL.md) を読み、計画を表示し、先に移動し、結果を検証してから 配信停止を送ります。レビューを飛ばすことはありません。 ## CLI でのクイックスタート **要件：** Python 3.11+、アカウントで IMAP 有効、ターミナル。`pip install` は不要です。 ```bash git clone https://github.com/jparedesDS/cleanyourmail.git cd cleanyourmail python tools/mail.py init --email you@example.com --secret-file ~/.secrets/cleanyourmail.txt ``` アプリパスワードを表示せずに保存します（`--clipboard` を付けるとクリップボードから読み取れます）： ```bash python tools/mail.py secret --provider gmail ``` Outlook の場合はアプリパスワードを省略し、Microsoft サインインを使います： ```bash python tools/mail.py connect outlook ``` 検証、スキャン、レビュー、計画： ```bash python tools/mail.py validate python tools/mail.py doctor python tools/mail.py scan --days 365 python tools/mail.py report --top 30 python tools/mail.py plan --mode folders ``` 移動を適用し、その後で配信停止を別々に実行します： ```bash python tools/mail.py apply --yes --action move python tools/mail.py unsubscribe --yes --limit 10 ``` 実行を元に戻す： ```bash python tools/mail.py journal python tools/mail.py undo --run --yes ``` `apply` は `--action` なしだと意図的に移動だけを行います。配信停止は不可逆なので、明示的に 要求する必要があります。`apply`、`unsubscribe`、`undo` には `--yes` が必要です。ない場合は アクションを表示してコード **3** で終了します。設定・接続・安全上の拒否はコード **2**、部分的な 失敗はコード **1** で終了します。 ## 安全モデル | 保証 | 仕組み | |---|---| | **完全削除なし** | 移動はまずコピーし、`UID EXPUNGE` のみを使います。メールボックス全体の EXPUNGE はなく、Trash も空にしません。UIDPLUS/MOVE がない場合は移動を拒否します。 | | **保護メール** | 銀行、セキュリティコード、請求書、旅行、医療、行政、法務、個人、スター付き、返信済み、最近のメールは自動で移動・配信停止されません。 | | **元に戻せる移動** | 追記専用の JSONL ジャーナルに COPYUID と Message-ID を記録します。Gmail アーカイブは `X-GM-MSGID` を記録します。`undo` は復元前にメッセージを検証します。 | | **安全な配信停止** | `List-Unsubscribe` ヘッダーのみ、RFC 8058 POST、リダイレクト/Cookie/プロキシなし、32 KB 上限、公開 HTTPS のみ、プライベート/ローカル宛先は拒否。 | | **プロンプトインジェクション耐性** | ヘッダーと件名はデータです。メール内の指示には従いません。手動リンクはあなたが開くものです。 | | **秘密情報をリポジトリに入れない** | アプリパスワードは `password_env` または非公開の `password_file` に保存され、`secret` が表示することはありません。Microsoft が保存するのは refresh token のみで、アカウントのパスワードは保存しません。状態ファイルは OS が対応する場合にプライベート権限を使います。 | 完全な脅威モデル：[docs/SAFETY.md](docs/SAFETY.md)。 ## プロバイダー | プロバイダー | 認証 | メモ | |---|---|---| | Gmail / Google Workspace | アプリパスワード（2FA 必須） | IMAP を有効化。ラベル、アーカイブ、Junk、All Mail。 | | Outlook.com / Microsoft 365 | Microsoft サインイン（`connect outlook`） | refresh token を保存し、自動で更新します。Microsoft 365 はテナント管理者の同意が必要で、Outlook.com の個人用は確認済みの発行元が必要です。テナントが SMTP AUTH を無効化する場合があります。 | | Yahoo | アプリパスワード | Account Security → Generate app password。 | | iCloud | アプリ専用パスワード | Apple の 2FA が必要。 | | Fastmail | アプリパスワード | スコープ付き IMAP/SMTP パスワード。Sieve エクスポート。 | | Proton | Proton Mail Bridge | Bridge の起動が必要。IMAP/SMTP のホスト、ポート、パスワードを使用。 | | カスタム IMAP | Login または XOAUTH2 | ホスト/ポート/TLS を設定。Trash/Junk/Archive には special-use フラグを使用。 | 詳細：[docs/PROVIDERS.md](docs/PROVIDERS.md)。 ## よく使うコマンド | コマンド | 内容 | メールを変更？ | |---|---|---| | `init` | 初期 `cleanyourmail.toml` を書き出します。 | いいえ | | `connect` | Microsoft の device code で Outlook にサインインします。 | いいえ | | `secret` | アプリパスワードを表示せずにローカルへ保存します。 | いいえ | | `validate` | 接続せずに TOML を検証します。 | いいえ | | `doctor` | ログインし、機能と特別フォルダを一覧表示します。 | いいえ | | `folders` | メールフォルダーを一覧表示または作成します。 | いいえ | | `scan` | ヘッダーをキャッシュし、メッセージを分類します。 | いいえ | | `report` | 送信者、カテゴリ、古いリスト、保護メールを表示します。 | いいえ | | `plan` | 移動と配信停止対象を含む `plan.json` を書き出します。 | いいえ | | `apply` | 移動を実行。`--action unsubscribe` で配信停止も。 | 移動/アーカイブ | | `unsubscribe` | 自動配信停止リクエストのみ送信します。 | リクエスト送信 | | `unsubs` | 配信停止の履歴を表示します。 | いいえ | | `journal` | 実行とジャーナル項目を表示します。 | いいえ | | `undo` | 実行の移動/アーカイブを復元します。 | 移動/アーカイブ | | `rules` | Gmail フィルター XML または Sieve を書き出します。 | いいえ | `--config path.toml` で別の設定、`--json` で機械可読出力を使えます。画面を共有する前に `report --redact --no-subjects` を使ってください。 ## 振り分けの決め方 | カテゴリ | 既定の移動先 | アクション | |---|---|---| | ニュースレター | `CleanYourMail/Newsletters` | 整理 + 自動なら配信停止 | | プロモーション | `CleanYourMail/Promotions` | 整理 + 自動なら配信停止 | | ソーシャル | `CleanYourMail/Social` | 整理 | | 通知 | `CleanYourMail/Notifications` | 整理 | | コールドメール | `CleanYourMail/Cold` | 整理 | | スパム | `Junk`（または `Spam`） | Junk へ移動。既に Junk のスパムは Trash へ | | トランザクション | 保持 | 自動移動しない | | パーソナル | 保持 | 自動移動しない | 分類には `List-Unsubscribe`、`List-ID`、`Precedence`、`Auto-Submitted`、 `Authentication-Results`、キャンペーンヘッダー、送信者ドメイン/ローカル部、英語とスペイン語の 件名表現を使います。意図的に保守的で、誤って「保持」する方が誤って移動するより安く済みます。 プランナーはさらに、`policy.min_age_days`（既定 30）より新しいメッセージ、スター付き/返信済み、 設定された保護アドレス/ドメイン、トランザクション/パーソナルメール、グループ/実行ごとの上限を 超えるものをスキップします。 ## Gmail、ラベル、アーカイブモード Gmail はフォルダではなくラベルです。`CleanYourMail/Newsletters` はネストしたラベルです。アーカイブ モードは `X-GM-LABELS` で `\Inbox` ラベルを外し、メッセージは All Mail に残ります。`undo` は `X-GM-MSGID`（または Message-ID）で見つけ、`\Inbox` を戻します。 他のプロバイダーでは、アーカイブモードはサーバーの `\Archive` または `\All` フォルダへ移動します。 どちらも通知されない場合、CLI は推測せず拒否します。 ## サーバー側のルール ```bash python tools/mail.py rules --format gmail --out gmail-filters.xml python tools/mail.py rules --format sieve --out cleanyourmail.sieve ``` フィルターは**新着メールのみ**に適用されます。既存メッセージは移動しません。Gmail：先にラベルを 作成し、Settings → Filters → Import で XML をインポートします。Sieve：スクリプトを確認し、 プロバイダーの画面からアップロードします。エクスポーターは保護・トランザクション・パーソナル・ スパムの送信者を除外します。 ## テスト ```bash python -m unittest discover -s tests -v ``` テストスイートはプロセス内の偽 IMAP サーバーを使い、実際のメールボックスやネットワークは不要です。 分類、パース、計画、store/journal、設定、URL 安全性、Gmail アーカイブ/undo、MOVE なし・UIDPLUS なしの拒否、CLI フロー、スキル文書をカバーします。 ## # CleanYourMail **받은편지함, 소음 없이.** 이메일 헤더만 읽는 로컬 에이전트 네이티브 스킬입니다. 뉴스레터, 프로모션, 소셜 알림, 콜드 메일, 스팸을 찾아 폴더나 라벨로 정리하고 안전하게 수신 거부합니다. 본문은 읽지 않고 영구 삭제도 하지 않습니다. 대부분의 받은편지함 정리 도구는 비밀번호를 요구하고, 메일을 읽고, 증거를 삭제합니다. CleanYourMail은 로컬에서 실행되고 헤더만 읽으며 모든 이동을 기록하므로 되돌릴 수 있습니다. [웹사이트](https://cleanyourmail.org/) · [SKILL.md](SKILL.md) · [PROMPT.md](PROMPT.md) · [보안](docs/SAFETY.md) ## 여기서 시작하세요 | 상황 | 시작 방법 | |---|---| | 메일함과 코딩 에이전트가 있음 | 아래의 에이전트 빠른 시작을 사용하세요. | | 터미널만 있고 에이전트는 없음 | 아래의 CLI 빠른 시작을 사용하세요. | | 먼저 보고 싶음 | [웹사이트](https://cleanyourmail.org/). | | 보안 규칙이 필요함 | [docs/SAFETY.md](docs/SAFETY.md). | ## CleanYourMail을 선택하는 이유 - **설계부터 프라이빗.** CLI는 로컬에서 실행됩니다. 헤더만 읽고 메타데이터를 저장하며, 텔레메트리나 타사 API가 없습니다. 유일한 예외는 선택형 피드백 도우미 `scripts/feedback.py`이며, `--yes`로 실행할 때만 검토된 페이로드를 전송합니다. - **기본이 되돌리기.** 모든 이동은 COPYUID와 Message-ID로 기록됩니다. 명령 하나로 복원할 수 있습니다. - **에이전트 전용이 아닌 에이전트 네이티브.** CLI가 제품입니다. `SKILL.md`와 `PROMPT.md`는 어떤 코딩 에이전트든 안전하게 사용하도록 가르칩니다. [호스팅형 정리 도구와 비교 →](https://cleanyourmail.org/#why) ## 하는 일 - **헤더만 스캔합니다.** 보낸사람, 제목, 날짜, 크기, 플래그, `List-Unsubscribe` 헤더. 본문, 첨부 파일, 전체 메일함 다운로드는 없습니다. - **분류**: 뉴스레터, 프로모션, 소셜, 알림, 콜드 메일, 스팸, 거래성, 개인. - **보호**: 은행, 보안 코드, 청구서, 여행, 의료, 정부, 법률, 개인, 별표, 답장한 메일, 최근 메일. 보호된 메시지는 표시되지만 자동으로 이동되거나 수신 거부되지 않습니다. - **행동 전에 계획합니다.** 정확한 UID, 대상, 수신 거부 대상을 담은 검토 가능한 `plan.json`을 작성합니다. `scan`, `report`, `plan` 중에는 아무것도 바뀌지 않습니다. - **되돌릴 수 있게 정리합니다.** 폴더/라벨, Junk, Trash로 이동합니다. Gmail 보관은 Inbox 라벨을 제거합니다. 모든 이동은 COPYUID와 Message-ID로 기록되며 `undo`로 복원됩니다. - **안전하게 수신 거부합니다.** RFC 8058 원클릭 POST, `mailto:`, 수동 링크. 본문 링크, 리디렉션, 쿠키, 로컬/사설 대상은 사용하지 않습니다. - **규칙 내보내기**: Gmail 필터와 Sieve. 검토 후 새 메일을 자동 정리할 수 있습니다. - **영구 삭제는 없습니다.** Trash를 비우지 않고, “영구 삭제”도 없으며, Trash 전체 EXPUNGE도 하지 않습니다. ## 하지 않는 일 - 메시지 본문이나 첨부 파일을 읽지 않습니다. - 일반 메일 발송, 답장, 전달, 비밀번호/2FA 변경을 하지 않습니다. - Google OAuth를 사용하지 않습니다(Gmail은 앱 비밀번호 사용). Microsoft는 내장된 device code 로그인을 사용하며 refresh token만 로컬에 저장합니다. - 서버 측 필터를 업로드하지 않습니다. 검토용으로 내보내기만 합니다. - 수신 거부 요청이 발신자를 멈춘다고 보장하지 않습니다. - Gmail 라벨을 실제 폴더로 만들지 않습니다. - 회사/학교 정책, IMAP 제한, Proton Bridge 요구 사항을 우회하지 않습니다. ## 에이전트 빠른 시작 1. 저장소를 클론하고 에이전트에서 폴더를 엽니다. 2. [`PROMPT.md`](PROMPT.md)를 붙여넣고 제공업체와 이메일 주소를 입력합니다. 3. `apply`를 허용하기 전에 `plan.json`을 검토합니다. 4. undo 명령을 보관합니다. ```bash git clone https://github.com/jparedesDS/cleanyourmail.git cd cleanyourmail ``` 에이전트는 [`SKILL.md`](SKILL.md)를 읽고, 계획을 보여주고, 먼저 이동하고, 결과를 검증한 뒤에만 수신 거부 요청을 보냅니다. 검토를 건너뛰지 않습니다. ## CLI 빠른 시작 **요구 사항:** Python 3.11+, 계정에서 IMAP 활성화, 터미널. `pip install`은 필요 없습니다. ```bash git clone https://github.com/jparedesDS/cleanyourmail.git cd cleanyourmail python tools/mail.py init --email you@example.com --secret-file ~/.secrets/cleanyourmail.txt ``` 앱 비밀번호를 표시하지 않고 저장합니다(`--clipboard`를 추가하면 클립보드에서 읽습니다): ```bash python tools/mail.py secret --provider gmail ``` Outlook은 앱 비밀번호 대신 Microsoft 로그인을 사용하세요: ```bash python tools/mail.py connect outlook ``` 검증, 스캔, 검토, 계획: ```bash python tools/mail.py validate python tools/mail.py doctor python tools/mail.py scan --days 365 python tools/mail.py report --top 30 python tools/mail.py plan --mode folders ``` 이동을 적용한 뒤 수신 거부를 별도로 실행합니다: ```bash python tools/mail.py apply --yes --action move python tools/mail.py unsubscribe --yes --limit 10 ``` 실행을 되돌리기: ```bash python tools/mail.py journal python tools/mail.py undo --run --yes ``` `apply`는 `--action` 없이 의도적으로 이동만 합니다. 수신 거부는 되돌릴 수 없으며 명시적으로 요청해야 합니다. `apply`, `unsubscribe`, `undo`에는 `--yes`가 필요합니다. 없으면 작업을 출력하고 코드 **3**으로 종료합니다. 설정, 연결, 보안 거부는 코드 **2**, 부분 실패는 코드 **1**로 종료합니다. ## 보안 모델 | 보장 | 방식 | |---|---| | **영구 삭제 없음** | 이동은 먼저 복사하고 `UID EXPUNGE`만 사용합니다. 전체 메일함 EXPUNGE는 없고 Trash도 비우지 않습니다. UIDPLUS/MOVE가 없으면 이동을 거부합니다. | | **보호 메일** | 은행, 보안 코드, 청구서, 여행, 의료, 정부, 법률, 개인, 별표, 답장한 메일, 최근 메일은 자동으로 이동되거나 수신 거부되지 않습니다. | | **되돌릴 수 있는 이동** | 추가 전용 JSONL 저널에 COPYUID와 Message-ID를 기록합니다. Gmail 보관은 `X-GM-MSGID`를 기록합니다. `undo`는 복원 전에 메시지를 검증합니다. | | **안전한 수신 거부** | `List-Unsubscribe` 헤더만, RFC 8058 POST, 리디렉션/쿠키/프록시 없음, 32 KB 제한, 공개 HTTPS만, 사설/로컬 대상 거부. | | **프롬프트 인젝션 방어** | 헤더와 제목은 데이터입니다. 메일 안의 지시를 따르지 않으며, 수동 링크는 사용자가 직접 엽니다. | | **비밀 값은 저장소 밖에** | 앱 비밀번호는 `password_env` 또는 비공개 `password_file`에 저장되며 `secret`은 이를 표시하지 않습니다. Microsoft는 refresh token만 저장하고 계정 비밀번호는 저장하지 않습니다. OS가 지원하면 상태 파일에 비공개 권한을 사용합니다. | 전체 위협 모델: [docs/SAFETY.md](docs/SAFETY.md). ## 메일 제공업체 | 제공업체 | 인증 | 참고 | |---|---|---| | Gmail / Google Workspace | 앱 비밀번호(2FA 필요) | IMAP 활성화. 라벨, 보관, Junk, All Mail. | | Outlook.com / Microsoft 365 | Microsoft 로그인(`connect outlook`) | refresh token을 저장하고 자동으로 갱신합니다. Microsoft 365는 테넌트 관리자 동의가 필요하고, Outlook.com 개인 계정은 확인된 게시자가 필요합니다. 테넌트가 SMTP AUTH를 막을 수 있습니다. | | Yahoo | 앱 비밀번호 | Account Security → Generate app password. | | iCloud | 앱 전용 비밀번호 | Apple 2FA 필요. | | Fastmail | 앱 비밀번호 | 범위가 제한된 IMAP/SMTP 비밀번호, Sieve 내보내기. | | Proton | Proton Mail Bridge | Bridge가 실행 중이어야 합니다. IMAP/SMTP 호스트, 포트, 비밀번호를 사용하세요. | | 사용자 지정 IMAP | Login 또는 XOAUTH2 | 호스트/포트/TLS 설정. Trash/Junk/Archive에는 special-use 플래그를 사용합니다. | 자세히: [docs/PROVIDERS.md](docs/PROVIDERS.md). ## 주요 명령 | 명령 | 하는 일 | 메일 변경? | |---|---|---| | `init` | 초기 `cleanyourmail.toml`을 작성합니다. | 아니요 | | `connect` | Microsoft device code로 Outlook에 로그인합니다. | 아니요 | | `secret` | 앱 비밀번호를 표시하지 않고 로컬에 저장합니다. | 아니요 | | `validate` | 연결 없이 TOML을 검사합니다. | 아니요 | | `doctor` | 로그인하고 기능과 특수 폴더를 나열합니다. | 아니요 | | `folders` | 메일 폴더를 나열하거나 만듭니다. | 아니요 | | `scan` | 헤더를 캐시하고 메시지를 분류합니다. | 아니요 | | `report` | 발신자, 카테고리, 오래된 목록, 보호 메일을 표시합니다. | 아니요 | | `plan` | 이동과 수신 거부 대상이 담긴 `plan.json`을 작성합니다. | 아니요 | | `apply` | 이동을 실행합니다. `--action unsubscribe`로 수신 거부도 가능합니다. | 이동/보관 | | `unsubscribe` | 자동 수신 거부 요청만 보냅니다. | 요청 전송 | | `unsubs` | 수신 거부 기록을 표시합니다. | 아니요 | | `journal` | 실행과 저널 항목을 표시합니다. | 아니요 | | `undo` | 실행의 이동/보관을 복원합니다. | 이동/보관 | | `rules` | Gmail 필터 XML 또는 Sieve를 내보냅니다. | 아니요 | `--config path.toml`로 다른 설정을, `--json`으로 기계 판독 가능한 출력을 사용할 수 있습니다. 화면을 공유하기 전에 `report --redact --no-subjects`를 사용하세요. ## 분류 방식 | 카테고리 | 기본 대상 | 작업 | |---|---|---| | 뉴스레터 | `CleanYourMail/Newsletters` | 정리 + 자동이면 수신 거부 | | 프로모션 | `CleanYourMail/Promotions` | 정리 + 자동이면 수신 거부 | | 소셜 | `CleanYourMail/Social` | 정리 | | 알림 | `CleanYourMail/Notifications` | 정리 | | 콜드 메일 | `CleanYourMail/Cold` | 정리 | | 스팸 | `Junk` (또는 `Spam`) | Junk로 이동. 이미 Junk인 스팸은 Trash로 | | 거래성 | 유지 | 자동 이동 안 함 | | 개인 | 유지 | 자동 이동 안 함 | 분류는 `List-Unsubscribe`, `List-ID`, `Precedence`, `Auto-Submitted`, `Authentication-Results`, 캠페인 헤더, 발신자 도메인/로컬 부분, 영어와 스페인어 제목 표현을 사용합니다. 의도적으로 보수적이며, 잘못 “유지”하는 것이 잘못 이동하는 것보다 비용이 적습니다. 플래너는 또한 `policy.min_age_days`(기본 30일)보다 최신 메시지, 별표/이미 답장한 메시지, 설정된 보호 주소/도메인, 거래성/개인 메일, 그룹/실행별 한도를 초과하는 항목을 건너뜁니다. ## Gmail, 라벨, 보관 모드 Gmail은 폴더가 아니라 라벨을 사용합니다. `CleanYourMail/Newsletters`는 중첩 라벨입니다. 보관 모드는 `X-GM-LABELS`로 `\Inbox` 라벨을 제거하며 메시지는 All Mail에 남습니다. `undo`는 `X-GM-MSGID`(또는 Message-ID)로 찾아 `\Inbox`를 다시 추가합니다. 다른 제공업체에서는 보관 모드가 메시지를 서버의 `\Archive` 또는 `\All` 폴더로 이동합니다. 서버가 둘 다 제공하지 않으면 CLI는 추측하지 않고 거부합니다. ## 서버 측 규칙 ```bash python tools/mail.py rules --format gmail --out gmail-filters.xml python tools/mail.py rules --format sieve --out cleanyourmail.sieve ``` 필터는 **새 메일만** 적용됩니다. 기존 메시지를 이동하지 않습니다. Gmail: 먼저 라벨을 만들고 Settings → Filters → Import에서 XML을 가져옵니다. Sieve: 스크립트를 검토하고 제공업체 인터페이스로 업로드합니다. 내보내기는 보호/거래성/개인/스팸 발신자를 제외합니다. ## 테스트 ```bash python -m unittest discover -s tests -v ``` 테스트 스위트는 프로세스 내 가짜 IMAP 서버를 사용하며 실제 메일함이나 네트워크가 필요 없습니다. 분류, 파싱, 계획, store/journal, 설정, URL 안전, Gmail 보관/undo, MOVE 없음 및 UIDPLUS 없음 거부, CLI 흐름, 스킬 문서를 다룹니다. ## 문서 - [SKILL.md](SKILL.md) — 에이전트 절차와 보안 규칙. - [PROMPT.md](PROMPT.md) / [PROMPT.es.md](PROMPT.es.md) — 스킬을 지원하지 않는 에이전트용 짧은 프롬프트. - [docs/SAFETY.md](docs/SAFETY.md) — 보호 메일, undo, 삭제 정책, 프롬프트 인젝션. - [docs/PROVIDERS.md](docs/PROVIDERS.md) — Gmail, Microsoft, Yahoo, iCloud, Fastmail, Proton, custom. - [docs/UNSUBSCRIBE.md](docs/UNSUBSCRIBE.md) — RFC 8058, mailto, 수동 링크, SSRF 가드. - [docs/FOLDERS.md](docs/FOLDERS.md) — 분류, Gmail 라벨, 보관 모드, 규칙. - [docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md](docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md) — 인증, IMAP, 폴더, 제한, undo. - [docs/FAQ.md](docs/FAQ.md) — 자주 묻는 질문. - [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) — 개발, 테스트, 보안 불변 조건. - [웹사이트](https://github.com/jparedesDS/cleanyourmail-web) — 정적 랜딩 페이지. ## 기여 [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md)와 [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md)를 읽어 주세요. 테스트는 실제 메일함 없이 통과해야 하며 `tests/fakeimap.py`를 사용합니다. 영구 삭제, 본문 읽기, Google OAuth, 텔레메트리, 전체 메일함 EXPUNGE를 추가하지 마세요. # CleanYourMail **Your inbox, minus the noise.** A local, agent-native skill that reads email headers, finds newsletters, promotions, social notifications, cold outreach and spam, files them into folders or labels, and sends unsubscribe requests — without reading message bodies and without permanently deleting anything. Most inbox cleaners ask for your password, read your mail and delete the evidence. CleanYourMail runs locally, reads headers only and journals every move, so you can undo it. [Website](https://cleanyourmail.org/) · [SKILL.md](SKILL.md) · [PROMPT.md](PROMPT.md) · [Safety](docs/SAFETY.md) ## Start here | You have | Start with | |---|---| | A mailbox and a coding agent | The agent quick start below. | | Prefer buttons over prompts | [Download the CleanYourMail app](https://github.com/jparedesDS/cleanyourmail-app). | | A terminal and no agent | The CLI quick start below. | | Want to see it first | [The website](https://cleanyourmail.org/). | | Need the safety rules | [docs/SAFETY.md](docs/SAFETY.md). | ## Why CleanYourMail - **Private by construction.** The CLI runs locally. It reads headers only, stores metadata, and has no telemetry or third-party API of its own. The separate opt-in feedback helper is the only exception: it posts a reviewed payload only when run with `--yes`. - **Reversible by default.** Every move is journaled with COPYUID and Message-ID. One command restores it. - **Agent-native, not agent-only.** The CLI is the product. `SKILL.md` and `PROMPT.md` teach any coding agent to use it safely. [Compare with hosted inbox cleaners →](https://cleanyourmail.org/#why) ## What it does - **Scans headers only.** Sender, subject, date, size, flags and `List-Unsubscribe` headers. No bodies, no attachments, no full-mailbox download. - **Classifies** mail into newsletter, promotion, social, notification, cold outreach, spam, transactional and personal. - **Protects** bank, security, invoice, travel, medical, government, legal, personal, starred, answered and recent mail. Protected messages are shown but never auto-moved or auto-unsubscribed. - **Plans before acting.** Writes a reviewable `plan.json` with exact UIDs, destinations and unsubscribe targets. Nothing changes during `scan`, `report` or `plan`. - **Files reversibly.** Moves to folders/labels, Junk or Trash; Gmail archive removes the Inbox label. Every move is journaled with COPYUID and Message-ID, and `undo` restores it. - **Unsubscribes safely.** RFC 8058 one-click POST, `mailto:`, or a manual link. No body links, no redirects, no cookies, no local/private targets. - **Exports rules** for Gmail filters and Sieve, so new mail can be filed automatically after you review the rules. - **Never permanently deletes.** No empty Trash, no “delete forever”, no bare expunge on Trash. ## What it does not do - It does not read message bodies or attachments. - It does not send normal email, reply, forward, or change passwords/2FA. - It does not acquire Google OAuth tokens; Gmail uses an App Password. Microsoft uses a built-in device-code sign-in and stores only a refresh token locally. - It does not upload server-side filters; it exports them for review. - It does not guarantee that an unsubscribe request stops a sender. - It does not make Gmail folders into real folders: Gmail labels are labels. - It does not bypass a work/school tenant policy, IMAP restrictions, or Proton Bridge requirements. ## Agent quick start 1. Clone the repository and open the folder in your coding agent. 2. Paste [`PROMPT.md`](PROMPT.md) and fill in your provider and email address. 3. Review `plan.json` before allowing `apply`. 4. Keep the undo command. ```bash git clone https://github.com/jparedesDS/cleanyourmail.git cd cleanyourmail ``` The agent reads [`SKILL.md`](SKILL.md), shows you the plan, moves first, verifies the result, and only then sends unsubscribe requests. It will not skip the review. ## CLI quick start **Requirements:** Python 3.11+, IMAP enabled on the account, and a terminal. No `pip install`. ```bash git clone https://github.com/jparedesDS/cleanyourmail.git cd cleanyourmail python tools/mail.py init --email you@example.com --secret-file ~/.secrets/cleanyourmail.txt ``` Save the app password without echoing it (add `--clipboard` to read it from the clipboard): ```bash python tools/mail.py secret --provider gmail ``` For Outlook, skip the app password and use the Microsoft sign-in: ```bash python tools/mail.py connect outlook ``` Validate, scan, review and plan: ```bash python tools/mail.py validate python tools/mail.py doctor python tools/mail.py scan --days 365 python tools/mail.py report --top 30 python tools/mail.py plan --mode folders ``` Apply moves, then unsubscribe separately: ```bash python tools/mail.py apply --yes --action move python tools/mail.py unsubscribe --yes --limit 10 ``` Undo a run: ```bash python tools/mail.py journal python tools/mail.py undo --run --yes ``` `apply` without `--action` is moves-only on purpose. Unsubscribe is irreversible and must be requested explicitly. `apply`, `unsubscribe` and `undo` require `--yes`; without it they print the actions and exit with code **3**. A config, connection or safety refusal exits with code **2**. Partial failures exit with code **1**. ## Safety model | Guarantee | How it works | |---|---| | **No permanent deletion** | Moves copy first and use `UID EXPUNGE` only. No mailbox-wide expunge; Trash is never emptied. If the server lacks UIDPLUS/MOVE, moves are refused. | | **Protected mail** | Banks, security codes, invoices, travel, medical, government, legal, personal, starred, answered and recent mail are never auto-moved or auto-unsubscribed. | | **Reversible moves** | An append-only JSONL journal records COPYUID and Message-ID. Gmail archive records `X-GM-MSGID`. `undo` verifies the message before restoring. | | **Safe unsubscribe** | `List-Unsubscribe` headers only, RFC 8058 POST, no redirects/cookies/proxies, 32 KB cap, public HTTPS only, private/local targets rejected. | | **Prompt-injection resistant** | Headers and subjects are data. Instructions inside email are never followed; manual links are for you to open. | | **Secrets stay out** | App passwords go to `password_env` or a private `password_file`; `secret` never echoes them. Microsoft stores only a refresh token, never the account password. State files use private permissions where the OS supports it. | Full threat model: [docs/SAFETY.md](docs/SAFETY.md). ## Providers | Provider | Authentication | Notes | |---|---|---| | Gmail / Google Workspace | App Password (2FA required) | Enable IMAP. Labels; archive; Junk; All Mail. | | Outlook.com / Microsoft 365 | Microsoft sign-in (`connect outlook`) | Stores a refresh token and renews it automatically. Microsoft 365 requires tenant admin consent; Outlook.com personal requires a verified publisher. SMTP AUTH may be disabled by the tenant. | | Yahoo | App password | Account Security → Generate app password. | | iCloud | App-specific password | Apple 2FA required. | | Fastmail | App password | Scoped IMAP/SMTP password; Sieve export. | | Proton | Proton Mail Bridge | Bridge must run; use its IMAP/SMTP host, port and password. | | Custom IMAP | Login or XOAUTH2 | Set host/port/TLS. Special-use flags are used for Trash/Junk/Archive. | More detail: [docs/PROVIDERS.md](docs/PROVIDERS.md). ## Common commands | Command | What it does | Changes mail? | |---|---|---| | `init` | Write a starter `cleanyourmail.toml`. | No | | `connect` | Sign in to Outlook with Microsoft (device code). | No | | `secret` | Save an app password locally without echoing it. | No | | `validate` | Check the TOML without connecting. | No | | `doctor` | Log in, list capabilities and special folders. | No | | `folders` | List or create mail folders. | No | | `scan` | Cache headers and classify messages. | No | | `report` | Show senders, categories, stale lists and protected mail. | No | | `plan` | Write `plan.json` with moves and unsubscribe targets. | No | | `apply` | Execute moves; add `--action unsubscribe` for requests. | Moves/archives | | `unsubscribe` | Send automatic unsubscribe requests only. | Sends requests | | `unsubs` | Show unsubscribe history. | No | | `journal` | Show runs and journal entries. | No | | `undo` | Restore a run's moves/archives. | Moves/archives | | `rules` | Export Gmail filter XML or Sieve. | No | Use `--config path.toml` for a non-default config and `--json` for machine-readable output. Use `report --redact --no-subjects` before sharing a screen. ## How it decides | Category | Destination by default | Action | |---|---|---| | newsletter | `CleanYourMail/Newsletters` | file + unsubscribe if automatic | | promotion | `CleanYourMail/Promotions` | file + unsubscribe if automatic | | social | `CleanYourMail/Social` | file | | notification | `CleanYourMail/Notifications` | file | | cold | `CleanYourMail/Cold` | file | | spam | `Junk` (or `Spam`) | move to Junk; already-junk spam may go to Trash | | transactional | kept | never auto-moved | | personal | kept | never auto-moved | Classification uses `List-Unsubscribe`, `List-ID`, `Precedence`, `Auto-Submitted`, `Authentication-Results`, campaign headers, sender domains/local parts, and subject wording in English and Spanish. It is deliberately conservative: a false “keep” is cheaper than a false move. The planner also skips messages younger than `policy.min_age_days` (default 30), starred or already answered, configured protected addresses/domains, transactional/personal mail, and anything over the per-group or per-run limits. ## Gmail, labels and archive mode Gmail has labels, not folders. `CleanYourMail/Newsletters` is a nested label. Archive mode removes the `\Inbox` label with `X-GM-LABELS`; the message remains in All Mail. Undo finds it by `X-GM-MSGID` (or Message-ID) and re-adds `\Inbox`. On other providers, archive mode moves messages to the server's `\Archive` or `\All` folder. If the server advertises neither, the CLI refuses rather than guessing. ## Server-side rules ```bash python tools/mail.py rules --format gmail --out gmail-filters.xml python tools/mail.py rules --format sieve --out cleanyourmail.sieve ``` Filters affect **new mail only**. They do not move existing messages. Gmail: create the labels first, then import the XML in Settings → Filters → Import. Sieve: review the script and upload it through the provider's interface. The exporter excludes protected, transactional, personal and spam senders. ## Tests ```bash python -m unittest discover -s tests -v ``` The suite uses an in-process fake IMAP server; it does not need a real mailbox or network. It covers classification, parsing, planning, store/journal, config, URL safety, Gmail archive/undo, no-MOVE and no-UIDPLUS refusals, CLI flows and the skill document. ## Documentation - [SKILL.md](SKILL.md) — the agent procedure and safety rules. - [PROMPT.md](PROMPT.md) / [PROMPT.es.md](PROMPT.es.md) — short prompts for agents without skills. - [docs/SAFETY.md](docs/SAFETY.md) — protected mail, undo, deletion policy, prompt injection. - [docs/PROVIDERS.md](docs/PROVIDERS.md) — Gmail, Microsoft, Yahoo, iCloud, Fastmail, Proton, custom. - [docs/UNSUBSCRIBE.md](docs/UNSUBSCRIBE.md) — RFC 8058, mailto, manual links, SSRF guard. - [docs/FOLDERS.md](docs/FOLDERS.md) — taxonomy, Gmail labels, archive mode, rules. - [docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md](docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md) — auth, IMAP, folders, rate limits, undo. - [docs/FAQ.md](docs/FAQ.md) - the questions people ask. - [docs/BRAND-SPECTRUM.md](docs/BRAND-SPECTRUM.md) - primary identity; [docs/BRAND-FAMILY.md](docs/BRAND-FAMILY.md) and [docs/BRAND.md](docs/BRAND.md) - alternate colorways. - [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) — development setup, tests and safety invariants. - [Website](https://github.com/jparedesDS/cleanyourmail-web) — the static landing page. ## Contributing Read [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) and [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md). # CleanYourMail **Sua caixa de entrada, sem o ruído.** Uma skill local e nativa para agentes que lê apenas cabeçalhos de e-mail, encontra newsletters, promoções, notificações sociais, contato frio e spam, arquiva em pastas ou marcadores e envia solicitações de descadastro — sem ler o corpo das mensagens e sem excluir nada permanentemente. A maioria dos limpadores de caixa de entrada pede sua senha, lê seus e-mails e apaga as evidências. O CleanYourMail roda localmente, lê apenas cabeçalhos e registra cada movimento para que você possa desfazer. [Site](https://cleanyourmail.org/) · [SKILL.md](SKILL.md) · [PROMPT.md](PROMPT.md) · [Segurança](docs/SAFETY.md) ## Comece aqui | Você tem | Comece por | |---|---| | Uma caixa de entrada e um agente | O início rápido com agente, abaixo. | | Um terminal e nenhum agente | O início rápido com a CLI, abaixo. | | Quer ver primeiro | [O site](https://cleanyourmail.org/). | | Precisa das regras de segurança | [docs/SAFETY.md](docs/SAFETY.md). | ## Por que CleanYourMail - **Privado por construção.** A CLI roda localmente. Lê apenas cabeçalhos, guarda metadados e não tem telemetria nem API de terceiros. A única exceção é o assistente de comentários opcional `scripts/feedback.py`, que só envia um conteúdo revisado quando executado com `--yes`. - **Reversível por padrão.** Cada movimento é registrado com COPYUID e Message-ID. Um comando restaura. - **Nativo para agentes, não só para agentes.** A CLI é o produto. `SKILL.md` e `PROMPT.md` ensinam qualquer agente a usá-la com segurança. [Comparar com limpadores hospedados →](https://cleanyourmail.org/#why) ## O que ele faz - **Lê apenas cabeçalhos.** Remetente, assunto, data, tamanho, flags e cabeçalhos `List-Unsubscribe`. Sem corpos, sem anexos, sem baixar a caixa inteira. - **Classifica** os e-mails em newsletter, promoção, social, notificação, contato frio, spam, transacional e pessoal. - **Protege** bancos, códigos de segurança, faturas, viagens, saúde, governo, jurídico, pessoal, favoritos, respondidos e recentes. Mensagens protegidas são exibidas, mas nunca movidas nem descadastradas automaticamente. - **Planeja antes de agir.** Escreve um `plan.json` revisável com UIDs exatos, destinos e alvos de descadastro. Nada muda durante `scan`, `report` ou `plan`. - **Arquiva de forma reversível.** Move para pastas/marcadores, Junk ou Trash; arquivar no Gmail remove o marcador Inbox. Cada movimento é registrado com COPYUID e Message-ID, e `undo` restaura. - **Descadastra com segurança.** POST one-click RFC 8058, `mailto:` ou link manual. Sem links do corpo, sem redirecionamentos, sem cookies, sem destinos locais/privados. - **Exporta regras** para filtros do Gmail e Sieve, para que novos e-mails sejam arquivados automaticamente depois que você revisar as regras. - **Nunca exclui permanentemente.** Não esvazia a Trash, não tem “excluir para sempre” e não faz expunge geral na Trash. ## O que ele não faz - Não lê corpos de mensagens nem anexos. - Não envia e-mail normal, não responde, não encaminha nem altera senhas/2FA. - Não usa OAuth do Google (o Gmail usa uma senha de app); o Microsoft usa o início de sessão integrado por device code e guarda apenas um refresh token localmente. - Não envia filtros para o servidor; exporta para revisão. - Não garante que um pedido de descadastro pare um remetente. - Não transforma marcadores do Gmail em pastas reais: marcadores do Gmail são marcadores. - Não contorna políticas de empresa/escola, restrições de IMAP ou requisitos do Proton Bridge. ## Início rápido com um agente 1. Clone o repositório e abra a pasta no seu agente. 2. Cole [`PROMPT.md`](PROMPT.md) e preencha seu provedor e endereço. 3. Revise `plan.json` antes de permitir `apply`. 4. Guarde o comando de undo. ```bash git clone https://github.com/jparedesDS/cleanyourmail.git cd cleanyourmail ``` O agente lê [`SKILL.md`](SKILL.md), mostra o plano, move primeiro, verifica o resultado e só então envia os pedidos de descadastro. Ele não pula a revisão. ## Início rápido com a CLI **Requisitos:** Python 3.11+, IMAP ativado na conta e um terminal. Sem `pip install`. ```bash git clone https://github.com/jparedesDS/cleanyourmail.git cd cleanyourmail python tools/mail.py init --email voce@exemplo.com --secret-file ~/.secrets/cleanyourmail.txt ``` Guarde a senha de app sem exibi-la (adicione `--clipboard` para lê-la da área de transferência): ```bash python tools/mail.py secret --provider gmail ``` Para o Outlook, dispense a senha de app e use o início de sessão da Microsoft: ```bash python tools/mail.py connect outlook ``` Valide, escaneie, revise e planeje: ```bash python tools/mail.py validate python tools/mail.py doctor python tools/mail.py scan --days 365 python tools/mail.py report --top 30 python tools/mail.py plan --mode folders ``` Aplique os movimentos e depois descadastre separadamente: ```bash python tools/mail.py apply --yes --action move python tools/mail.py unsubscribe --yes --limit 10 ``` Desfaça uma execução: ```bash python tools/mail.py journal python tools/mail.py undo --run --yes ``` `apply` sem `--action` só move, de propósito. O descadastro é irreversível e precisa ser pedido explicitamente. `apply`, `unsubscribe` e `undo` exigem `--yes`; sem ele, imprimem as ações e saem com código **3**. Uma recusa de configuração, conexão ou segurança sai com código **2**. Falhas parciais saem com código **1**. ## Modelo de segurança | Garantia | Como funciona | |---|---| | **Sem exclusão permanente** | Os movimentos copiam primeiro e usam apenas `UID EXPUNGE`. Sem expunge geral; a Trash nunca é esvaziada. Se o servidor não tiver UIDPLUS/MOVE, o movimento é recusado. | | **E-mail protegido** | Bancos, códigos de segurança, faturas, viagens, saúde, governo, jurídico, pessoal, favoritos, respondidos e recentes nunca são movidos nem descadastrados automaticamente. | | **Movimentos reversíveis** | Um journal JSONL append-only registra COPYUID e Message-ID. Arquivar no Gmail registra `X-GM-MSGID`. `undo` verifica a mensagem antes de restaurar. | | **Descadastro seguro** | Apenas cabeçalhos `List-Unsubscribe`, POST RFC 8058, sem redirecionamentos/cookies/proxies, limite de 32 KB, apenas HTTPS público, destinos privados/locais recusados. | | **Resistente a prompt injection** | Cabeçalhos e assuntos são dados. Instruções dentro de e-mails nunca são seguidas; links manuais são para você abrir. | | **Segredos fora do repositório** | As senhas de app vão para `password_env` ou para um `password_file` privado; `secret` nunca as exibe. A Microsoft guarda apenas um refresh token, nunca a senha da conta. Arquivos de estado usam permissões privadas quando o sistema permite. | Modelo de ameaças completo: [docs/SAFETY.md](docs/SAFETY.md). ## Provedores | Provedor | Autenticação | Notas | |---|---|---| | Gmail / Google Workspace | App Password (2FA obrigatória) | Ative IMAP. Marcadores; arquivo; Junk; All Mail. | | Outlook.com / Microsoft 365 | Login da Microsoft (`connect outlook`) | Guarda um refresh token e o renova automaticamente. O Microsoft 365 exige consentimento do administrador do tenant; o Outlook.com pessoal exige um publisher verificado. O tenant pode desativar SMTP AUTH. | | Yahoo | Senha de app | Account Security → Generate app password. | | iCloud | Senha específica de app | Apple exige 2FA. | | Fastmail | Senha de app | Senha IMAP/SMTP com escopo; exportação Sieve. | | Proton | Proton Mail Bridge | O Bridge precisa estar rodando; use host, porta e senha IMAP/SMTP dele. | | IMAP próprio | Login ou XOAUTH2 | Configure host/porta/TLS. Flags special-use são usadas para Trash/Junk/Archive. | Mais detalhes: [docs/PROVIDERS.md](docs/PROVIDERS.md). ## Comandos comuns | Comando | O que faz | Muda o e-mail? | |---|---|---| | `init` | Escreve um `cleanyourmail.toml` inicial. | Não | | `connect` | Entra no Outlook com a Microsoft (device code). | Não | | `secret` | Guarda uma senha de app localmente sem exibi-la. | Não | | `validate` | Valida o TOML sem conectar. | Não | | `doctor` | Entra na conta, lista recursos e pastas especiais. | Não | | `folders` | Lista ou cria pastas de correio. | Não | | `scan` | Guarda cabeçalhos e classifica mensagens. | Não | | `report` | Mostra remetentes, categorias, listas antigas e e-mail protegido. | Não | | `plan` | Escreve `plan.json` com movimentos e alvos de descadastro. | Não | | `apply` | Executa movimentos; adicione `--action unsubscribe` para descadastros. | Move/arquiva | | `unsubscribe` | Envia apenas pedidos automáticos de descadastro. | Envia pedidos | | `unsubs` | Mostra o histórico de descadastros. | Não | | `journal` | Mostra execuções e entradas do journal. | Não | | `undo` | Restaura movimentos/arquivamentos de uma execução. | Move/arquiva | | `rules` | Exporta XML de filtros do Gmail ou Sieve. | Não | Use `--config path.toml` para uma configuração não padrão e `--json` para saída legível por máquina. É deliberadamente conservadora: um falso “manter” custa menos que um falso movimento. O planejador também ignora mensagens mais novas que `policy.min_age_days` (30 por padrão), favoritas ou já respondidas, endereços/domínios protegidos, e-mail transacional/pessoal e tudo que passar dos limites por grupo ou por execução. ## Gmail, marcadores e modo arquivo O Gmail tem marcadores, não pastas. `CleanYourMail/Newsletters` é um marcador aninhado. O modo arquivo remove o marcador `\Inbox` com `X-GM-LABELS`; a mensagem permanece em All Mail. O undo a encontra por `X-GM-MSGID` (ou Message-ID) e adiciona `\Inbox` de volta. Em outros provedores, o modo arquivo move as mensagens para a pasta `\Archive` ou `\All` do servidor. Se o servidor não anunciar nenhuma das duas, a CLI recusa em vez de adivinhar. ## Regras no servidor ```bash python tools/mail.py rules --format gmail --out gmail-filters.xml python tools/mail.py rules --format sieve --out cleanyourmail.sieve ``` Os filtros afetam **apenas e-mails novos**. Não movem mensagens existentes. Gmail: crie os marcadores primeiro e importe o XML em Settings → Filters → Import. Sieve: revise o script e envie pela interface do provedor. O exportador exclui remetentes protegidos, transacionais, pessoais e spam. ## Testes ```bash python -m unittest discover -s tests -v ``` A suíte usa um servidor IMAP falso em processo; não precisa de caixa real nem de rede. # CleanYourMail **你的收件箱，少一点噪音。** 一个本地运行、面向智能体的技能：只读取邮件头，找出简报、促销、社交 通知、冷邮件和垃圾邮件，归档到文件夹或标签，并在安全时发送退订请求——不读取正文，也绝不永久删除。 大多数收件箱清理工具会索要密码、读取邮件并删除证据。CleanYourMail 在本地运行，只读邮件头，并 记录每一次移动，所以你可以撤销。 [网站](https://cleanyourmail.org/) · [SKILL.md](SKILL.md) · [PROMPT.md](PROMPT.md) · [安全](docs/SAFETY.md) ## 从这里开始 | 你的情况 | 开始方式 | |---|---| | 有邮箱和编程智能体 | 使用下面的智能体快速开始。 | | 只有终端，没有智能体 | 使用下面的 CLI 快速开始。 | | 想先看看效果 | [网站](https://cleanyourmail.org/)。 | | 需要安全规则 | [docs/SAFETY.md](docs/SAFETY.md)。 | ## 为什么选择 CleanYourMail - **从设计上保护隐私。** CLI 在本地运行，只读邮件头，保存元数据，没有遥测，也没有第三方 API。唯一的例外是可选的反馈辅助脚本 `scripts/feedback.py`：只有在使用 `--yes` 运行时，它才会发送经过审核的内容。 - **默认可撤销。** 每次移动都用 COPYUID 和 Message-ID 记录，一条命令即可恢复。 - **为智能体而生，但不只属于智能体。** CLI 就是产品。`SKILL.md` 和 `PROMPT.md` 让任何编程智能体 都能安全使用。 [与托管式清理工具对比 →](https://cleanyourmail.org/#why) ## 它能做什么 - **只扫描邮件头。** 发件人、主题、日期、大小、标记和 `List-Unsubscribe` 头。不读取正文，不下载 附件，也不下载整个邮箱。 - **分类**：简报、促销、社交、通知、冷邮件、垃圾邮件、交易邮件和个人邮件。 - **保护**银行、安全验证码、发票、旅行、医疗、政府、法律、个人、星标、已回复和近期邮件。受保护 邮件会显示，但绝不会被自动移动或退订。 - **先计划再执行。** 生成可审阅的 `plan.json`，包含精确 UID、目标和退订对象。`scan`、`report`、 `plan` 期间不会改变任何东西。 - **可逆归档。** 移动到文件夹/标签、Junk 或 Trash；Gmail 归档会移除 Inbox 标签。每次移动都用 COPYUID 和 Message-ID 记录，`undo` 可恢复。 - **安全退订。** RFC 8058 一键 POST、`mailto:` 或手动链接。不使用正文链接、重定向、Cookie 或 本地/私有目标。 - **导出规则**：Gmail 过滤器和 Sieve。你审阅后，新邮件可以自动归档。 - **绝不永久删除。** 不清空 Trash，没有“永久删除”，也不会对 Trash 做全邮箱 EXPUNGE。 ## 它不做什么 - 不读取邮件正文或附件。 - 不发送普通邮件、不回复、不转发，也不修改密码/2FA。 - 不使用 Google OAuth（Gmail 使用应用专用密码）；Microsoft 使用内置的 device code 登录，并且只在 本地保存 refresh token。 - 不上传服务器端过滤器；只导出供你审阅。 - 不保证退订请求一定能阻止发件人。 - 不会把 Gmail 标签变成真正的文件夹。 - 不绕过公司/学校政策、IMAP 限制或 Proton Bridge 要求。 ## 智能体快速开始 1. 克隆仓库，并在智能体中打开该文件夹。 2. 粘贴 [`PROMPT.md`](PROMPT.md)，填写服务商和邮箱地址。 3. 在允许 `apply` 前审阅 `plan.json`。 4. 保存 undo 命令。 ```bash git clone https://github.com/jparedesDS/cleanyourmail.git cd cleanyourmail ``` 智能体会读取 [`SKILL.md`](SKILL.md)，展示计划，先移动，验证结果，然后才发送退订请求。它不会跳过 审阅。 ## CLI 快速开始 **要求：** Python 3.11+、账户已启用 IMAP，以及终端。无需 `pip install`。 ```bash git clone https://github.com/jparedesDS/cleanyourmail.git cd cleanyourmail python tools/mail.py init --email you@example.com --secret-file ~/.secrets/cleanyourmail.txt ``` 保存应用专用密码而不回显（加上 `--clipboard` 可从剪贴板读取）： ```bash python tools/mail.py secret --provider gmail ``` 使用 Outlook 时，跳过应用专用密码，改用 Microsoft 登录： ```bash python tools/mail.py connect outlook ``` 验证、扫描、审阅并生成计划： ```bash python tools/mail.py validate python tools/mail.py doctor python tools/mail.py scan --days 365 python tools/mail.py report --top 30 python tools/mail.py plan --mode folders ``` 执行移动，然后单独退订： ```bash python tools/mail.py apply --yes --action move python tools/mail.py unsubscribe --yes --limit 10 ``` 撤销一次运行： ```bash python tools/mail.py journal python tools/mail.py undo --run --yes ``` `apply` 不带 `--action` 时只执行移动，这是有意设计。退订不可逆，必须明确请求。`apply`、 `unsubscribe` 和 `undo` 都需要 `--yes`；否则会打印操作并以代码 **3** 退出。配置、连接或安全拒绝 以代码 **2** 退出。部分失败以代码 **1** 退出。 ## 安全模型 | 保证 | 实现方式 | |---|---| | **不永久删除** | 移动先复制，只使用 `UID EXPUNGE`。不做全邮箱 EXPUNGE，绝不清空 Trash。服务器不支持 UIDPLUS/MOVE 时拒绝移动。 | | **保护邮件** | 银行、安全验证码、发票、旅行、医疗、政府、法律、个人、星标、已回复和近期邮件绝不会被自动移动或退订。 | | **可逆移动** | 追加式 JSONL 日志记录 COPYUID 和 Message-ID。Gmail 归档记录 `X-GM-MSGID`。`undo` 在恢复前验证邮件。 | | **安全退订** | 仅使用 `List-Unsubscribe` 头，RFC 8058 POST，无重定向/Cookie/代理，32 KB 上限，仅公网 HTTPS，拒绝私有/本地目标。 | | **抵御提示注入** | 邮件头和主题都是数据。邮件里的指令永远不会被执行；手动链接由你自己打开。 | | **密钥不进入仓库** | 应用密码保存到 `password_env` 或私有的 `password_file`；`secret` 绝不会回显它们。Microsoft 只保存 refresh token，绝不保存账户密码。操作系统支持时，状态文件使用私有权限。 | 完整威胁模型：[docs/SAFETY.md](docs/SAFETY.md)。 ## 邮件服务商 | 服务商 | 认证 | 说明 | |---|---|---| | Gmail / Google Workspace | 应用专用密码（需 2FA） | 启用 IMAP。标签、归档、Junk、All Mail。 | | Outlook.com / Microsoft 365 | Microsoft 登录（`connect outlook`） | 保存 refresh token 并自动续期。Microsoft 365 需要租户管理员同意；Outlook.com 个人版需要已验证的发布者。租户可能禁用 SMTP AUTH。 | | Yahoo | 应用密码 | Account Security → Generate app password。 | | iCloud | App 专用密码 | 需要 Apple 2FA。 | | Fastmail | 应用密码 | 有范围的 IMAP/SMTP 密码；Sieve 导出。 | | Proton | Proton Mail Bridge | 必须运行 Bridge；使用其 IMAP/SMTP 主机、端口和密码。 | | 自定义 IMAP | Login 或 XOAUTH2 | 设置主机/端口/TLS。Trash/Junk/Archive 使用 special-use 标记。 | 更多细节：[docs/PROVIDERS.md](docs/PROVIDERS.md)。 ## 常用命令 | 命令 | 作用 | 会修改邮件吗？ | |---|---|---| | `init` | 生成初始 `cleanyourmail.toml`。 | 否 | | `connect` | 使用 Microsoft device code 登录 Outlook。 | 否 | | `secret` | 在本地保存应用密码而不回显。 | 否 | | `validate` | 不连接即可检查 TOML。 | 否 | | `doctor` | 登录，列出能力和特殊文件夹。 | 否 | | `folders` | 列出或创建邮件文件夹。 | 否 | | `scan` | 缓存邮件头并分类邮件。 | 否 | | `report` | 显示发件人、类别、旧列表和受保护邮件。 | 否 | | `plan` | 生成包含移动和退订目标的 `plan.json`。 | 否 | | `apply` | 执行移动；加 `--action unsubscribe` 可退订。 | 移动/归档 | | `unsubscribe` | 只发送自动退订请求。 | 发送请求 | | `unsubs` | 显示退订历史。 | 否 | | `journal` | 显示运行和日志条目。 | 否 | | `undo` | 恢复某次运行的移动/归档。 | 移动/归档 | | `rules` | 导出 Gmail 过滤器 XML 或 Sieve。 | 否 | 使用 `--config path.toml` 指定非默认配置，使用 `--json` 获取机器可读输出。分享屏幕前使用 `report --redact --no-subjects`。 ## 如何分类 | 类别 | 默认目标 | 操作 | |---|---|---| | 简报 | `CleanYourMail/Newsletters` | 归档 + 自动退订（如适用） | | 促销 | `CleanYourMail/Promotions` | 归档 + 自动退订（如适用） | | 社交 | `CleanYourMail/Social` | 归档 | | 通知 | `CleanYourMail/Notifications` | 归档 | | 冷邮件 | `CleanYourMail/Cold` | 归档 | | 垃圾邮件 | `Junk`（或 `Spam`） | 移到 Junk；已在 Junk 的垃圾邮件可移到 Trash | | 交易邮件 | 保留 | 永不自动移动 | | 个人邮件 | 保留 | 永不自动移动 | 分类使用 `List-Unsubscribe`、`List-ID`、`Precedence`、`Auto-Submitted`、`Authentication-Results`、 营销头、发件人域名/本地部分，以及英语和西班牙语的主题措辞。它刻意保守：错误地“保留”比错误地 移动代价更低。 规划器还会跳过比 `policy.min_age_days`（默认 30 天）更新的邮件、星标或已回复邮件、配置的保护 地址/域名、交易/个人邮件，以及超过单组或单次运行上限的邮件。 ## Gmail、标签和归档模式 Gmail 使用标签而不是文件夹。`CleanYourMail/Newsletters` 是嵌套标签。归档模式通过 `X-GM-LABELS` 移除 `\Inbox` 标签，邮件仍留在 All Mail。`undo` 通过 `X-GM-MSGID`（或 Message-ID）找到它并重新 添加 `\Inbox`。 在其他服务商上，归档模式会把邮件移动到服务器的 `\Archive` 或 `\All` 文件夹。如果服务器两者都 不提供，CLI 会拒绝而不是猜测。 ## 服务器端规则 ```bash python tools/mail.py rules --format gmail --out gmail-filters.xml python tools/mail.py rules --format sieve --out cleanyourmail.sieve ``` 过滤器**只影响新邮件**，不会移动已有邮件。Gmail：先创建标签，然后在 Settings → Filters → Import 导入 XML。Sieve：审阅脚本，再通过服务商界面上传。导出器会排除受保护、交易、个人和垃圾邮件发件人。 ## 测试 ```bash python -m unittest discover -s tests -v ``` 测试套件使用进程内假 IMAP 服务器，不需要真实邮箱或网络。覆盖分类、解析、规划、store/journal、 配置、URL 安全、Gmail 归档/undo、无 MOVE 和无 UIDPLUS 拒绝、CLI 流程以及技能文档。 ## 文档 - [SKILL.md](SKILL.md) — 智能体流程和安全规则。 - [PROMPT.md](PROMPT.md) / [PROMPT.es.md](PROMPT.es.md) — 面向不支持技能智能体的短提示。 - [docs/SAFETY.md](docs/SAFETY.md) — 保护邮件、undo、删除政策、提示注入。 - [docs/PROVIDERS.md](docs/PROVIDERS.md) — Gmail、Microsoft、Yahoo、iCloud、Fastmail、Proton、自定义。 - [docs/UNSUBSCRIBE.md](docs/UNSUBSCRIBE.md) — RFC 8058、mailto、手动链接、SSRF 防护。 - [docs/FOLDERS.md](docs/FOLDERS.md) — 分类、Gmail 标签、归档模式、规则。 - [docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md](docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md) — 认证、IMAP、文件夹、限制、undo。 - [docs/FAQ.md](docs/FAQ.md) — 常见问题。 - [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) — 开发、测试和安全不变量。 - [网站](https://github.com/jparedesDS/cleanyourmail-web) — 静态落地页。 ## 贡献 请阅读 [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) 和 [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md)。测试必须在没有真实邮箱的 情况下通过；使用 `tests/fakeimap.py`。不要添加永久删除、正文读取、Google OAuth、遥测或全邮箱 EXPUNGE。Microsoft 登录仅限于 `tools/oauth_ms.py` 中的 device code 流程；不得添加 client secret。 ## 代理快速開始 1. 複製儲存庫，並在代理中開啟該資料夾。 2. 貼上 [`PROMPT.md`](PROMPT.md)，填入服務商和電子郵件地址。 3. 在允許 `apply` 前審閱 `plan.json`。 4. 保存 undo 指令。 ```bash git clone https://github.com/jparedesDS/cleanyourmail.git cd cleanyourmail ``` 代理會讀取 [`SKILL.md`](SKILL.md)，顯示計畫，先移動，驗證結果，然後才送出退訂請求。它不會跳過 審閱。 ## CLI 快速開始 **需求：** Python 3.11+、帳號已啟用 IMAP，以及終端機。不需要 `pip install`。 ```bash git clone https://github.com/jparedesDS/cleanyourmail.git cd cleanyourmail python tools/mail.py init --email you@example.com --secret-file ~/.secrets/cleanyourmail.txt ``` 儲存應用程式專用密碼而不顯示（加上 `--clipboard` 可從剪貼簿讀取）： ```bash python tools/mail.py secret --provider gmail ``` 使用 Outlook 時，略過應用程式專用密碼，改用 Microsoft 登入： ```bash python tools/mail.py connect outlook ``` 驗證、掃描、審閱並產生計畫： ```bash python tools/mail.py validate python tools/mail.py doctor python tools/mail.py scan --days 365 python tools/mail.py report --top 30 python tools/mail.py plan --mode folders ``` 執行移動，然後另外退訂： ```bash python tools/mail.py apply --yes --action move python tools/mail.py unsubscribe --yes --limit 10 ``` 復原一次執行： ```bash python tools/mail.py journal python tools/mail.py undo --run --yes ``` `apply` 不加 `--action` 時只執行移動，這是刻意設計。退訂不可逆，必須明確要求。`apply`、 `unsubscribe` 和 `undo` 都需要 `--yes`；否則會印出動作並以代碼 **3** 結束。設定、連線或安全拒絕 以代碼 **2** 結束。部分失敗以代碼 **1** 結束。 ## 安全模型 | 保證 | 實作方式 | |---|---| | **不永久刪除** | 移動先複製，只使用 `UID EXPUNGE`。不做全信箱 EXPUNGE，絕不清空 Trash。伺服器不支援 UIDPLUS/MOVE 時拒絕移動。 | | **保護郵件** | 銀行、安全驗證碼、發票、旅行、醫療、政府、法律、個人、星號、已回覆和近期郵件絕不會被自動移動或退訂。 | | **可逆移動** | 附加式 JSONL 日誌記錄 COPYUID 和 Message-ID。Gmail 封存記錄 `X-GM-MSGID`。`undo` 在還原前驗證郵件。 | | **安全退訂** | 僅使用 `List-Unsubscribe` 標頭，RFC 8058 POST，無重新導向/Cookie/代理，32 KB 上限，僅公開 HTTPS，拒絕私有/本機目標。 | | **抵禦提示注入** | 郵件標頭和主旨都是資料。郵件裡的指令永遠不會被執行；手動連結由你自己開啟。 | | **密鑰不進入儲存庫** | 應用程式密碼會存入 `password_env` 或私有的 `password_file`；`secret` 絕不顯示它們。Microsoft 只儲存 refresh token，絕不儲存帳號密碼。作業系統支援時，狀態檔案使用私有權限。 | 完整威脅模型：[docs/SAFETY.md](docs/SAFETY.md)。 ## 郵件服務商 | 服務商 | 驗證 | 說明 | |---|---|---| | Gmail / Google Workspace | 應用程式密碼（需 2FA） | 啟用 IMAP。標籤、封存、Junk、All Mail。 | | Outlook.com / Microsoft 365 | Microsoft 登入（`connect outlook`） | 儲存 refresh token 並自動更新。Microsoft 365 需要租用戶管理員同意；Outlook.com 個人版需要已驗證的發行者。租用戶可能停用 SMTP AUTH。 | | Yahoo | 應用程式密碼 | Account Security → Generate app password。 | | iCloud | App 專用密碼 | 需要 Apple 2FA。 | | Fastmail | 應用程式密碼 | 有範圍的 IMAP/SMTP 密碼；Sieve 匯出。 | | Proton | Proton Mail Bridge | 必須執行 Bridge；使用其 IMAP/SMTP 主機、連接埠和密碼。 | | 自訂 IMAP | Login 或 XOAUTH2 | 設定主機/連接埠/TLS。Trash/Junk/Archive 使用 special-use 旗標。 | 更多細節：[docs/PROVIDERS.md](docs/PROVIDERS.md)。 ## 常用指令 | 指令 | 作用 | 會修改郵件嗎？ | |---|---|---| | `init` | 產生初始 `cleanyourmail.toml`。 | 否 | | `connect` | 使用 Microsoft device code 登入 Outlook。 | 否 | | `secret` | 在本機儲存應用程式密碼而不顯示。 | 否 | | `validate` | 不連線即可檢查 TOML。 | 否 | | `doctor` | 登入，列出能力和特殊資料夾。 | 否 | | `folders` | 列出或建立郵件資料夾。 | 否 | | `scan` | 快取標頭並分類郵件。 | 否 | | `report` | 顯示寄件者、類別、舊清單和受保護郵件。 | 否 | | `plan` | 產生包含移動和退訂目標的 `plan.json`。 | 否 | | `apply` | 執行移動；加 `--action unsubscribe` 可退訂。 | 移動/封存 | | `unsubscribe` | 只送出自動退訂請求。 | 送出請求 | | `unsubs` | 顯示退訂歷史。 | 否 | | `journal` | 顯示執行和日誌項目。 | 否 | | `undo` | 還原某次執行的移動/封存。 | 移動/封存 | | `rules` | 匯出 Gmail 篩選器 XML 或 Sieve。 | 否 | 使用 `--config path.toml` 指定非預設設定，使用 `--json` 取得機器可讀輸出。分享畫面前使用 `report --redact --no-subjects`。 ## 如何分類 | 類別 | 預設目標 | 動作 | |---|---|---| | 電子報 | `CleanYourMail/Newsletters` | 歸檔 + 自動退訂（如適用） | | 促銷 | `CleanYourMail/Promotions` | 歸檔 + 自動退訂（如適用） | | 社群 | `CleanYourMail/Social` | 歸檔 | | 通知 | `CleanYourMail/Notifications` | 歸檔 | | 冷郵件 | `CleanYourMail/Cold` | 歸檔 | | 垃圾郵件 | `Junk`（或 `Spam`） | 移到 Junk；已在 Junk 的垃圾郵件可移到 Trash | | 交易郵件 | 保留 | 永不自動移動 | | 個人郵件 | 保留 | 永不自動移動 | 分類使用 `List-Unsubscribe`、`List-ID`、`Precedence`、`Auto-Submitted`、`Authentication-Results`、 行銷標頭、寄件者網域/本機部分，以及英語和西班牙語的主旨措辭。它刻意保守：錯誤地「保留」比錯誤地 移動代價更低。 規劃器也會跳過比 `policy.min_age_days`（預設 30 天）更新的郵件、星號或已回覆郵件、設定的保護 地址/網域、交易/個人郵件，以及超過單組或單次執行上限的郵件。 ## Gmail、標籤和封存模式 Gmail 使用標籤而不是資料夾。`CleanYourMail/Newsletters` 是巢狀標籤。封存模式透過 `X-GM-LABELS` 移除 `\Inbox` 標籤，郵件仍留在 All Mail。`undo` 透過 `X-GM-MSGID`（或 Message-ID）找到它並重新 加入 `\Inbox`。 在其他服務商上，封存模式會把郵件移動到伺服器的 `\Archive` 或 `\All` 資料夾。如果伺服器兩者都 不提供，CLI 會拒絕而不是猜測。 ## 伺服器端規則 ```bash python tools/mail.py rules --format gmail --out gmail-filters.xml python tools/mail.py rules --format sieve --out cleanyourmail.sieve ``` 篩選器**只影響新郵件**，不會移動既有郵件。Gmail：先建立標籤，然後在 Settings → Filters → Import 匯入 XML。Sieve：審閱腳本，再透過服務商介面上傳。匯出器會排除受保護、交易、個人和垃圾郵件寄件者。 ## # CleanYourMail — Family Brand Identity

> **Alternate identity:** CleanYourPhone-aligned lavender/gold palette. The primary CleanYourMail identity is [Spectrum](../final-spectrum/README.md): pastel orange envelope and mint return arrow.

## 1. The idea

CleanYourMail now follows the **CleanYourPhone family** language: a carbon rounded-square tile, a lavender outline and a single gold action. The mark is the **Return Fold**: an envelope whose right and bottom perimeter folds into a left-return arrow. The envelope is lavender; the return arrow is gold. The wordmark keeps “CleanYour” in off-white and “Mail” in lavender.

- **Name:** `CleanYourMail` (capital **C**, **Y**, **M**).
- **One-liner:** CleanYourMail is a local-first IMAP cleanup product: a Python CLI and agent skill today, with a desktop app in development. It reads headers only, plans before action, and gives every move a way back.
- **Taglines:** **Your inbox, minus the noise.** · **Tu bandeja, sin el ruido.**
- **Family idea:** **Control, not magic.**

## 3. Logo construction

- **Symbol:** 512×512 carbon tile (`rx=112`), lavender envelope (`#A78BFA`, 30-unit round stroke), gold return arrow (`#E2C15C`, 30-unit round stroke).
- **Favicon:** 64×64 simplified version for 16–32 px, same lavender/gold split.
- **App icon:** 1024×1024 carbon rounded square with 96 px safe margins and a subtle `#23252D` inner rim.
- **Wordmark:** outlined vector paths: `CleanYour` in `#ECE9E2`, `Mail` in `#C4B5FD`.
- **Lockups:** horizontal and stacked, with no three-stripe ribbon. The family uses a clean two-color mark, not a decorative spectrum bar.
- **Clear space:** 25% of the visible tile width around any mark.
- **Minimum sizes:** favicon 16 px; symbol 24 px standalone; horizontal/light lockup 160 px wide; wordmark 120 px wide.

## 4. Do / Don't

### Do

- Keep the lavender envelope and gold return arrow.
- Use gold for primary actions and plan/review.
- Use lavender for links, journal and undo.
- Reserve coral for the irreversible unsubscribe state only.
- Use the exact `CleanYourMail` casing.
- Say **headers only**, never “no email data at all”.
- Say **reversible moves**, not “everything is reversible”.

### Don't

- Don’t fill the symbol tile with gold or use the old sparkle.
- Don’t use purple gradients, neon glows, robots, shields or magic wands.
- Don’t use coral as a general brand color.
- Don’t put the dark-background wordmark on a light background without `light.svg`.
- Don’t include fake testimonials, user counts or fixed test counts.

# CleanYourMail — Spectrum Brand Identity & App Icon Guide


## 1. Brand idea & colorway overview

- **Name:** `CleanYourMail` (exact casing: capital **C**, **Y**, **M**; never rename, split with spaces, or publicly abbreviate).
- **Mark:** **Return Fold** (identical geometry to `brand/final/`): a rounded-square tile containing an envelope whose right and bottom perimeter folds continuously into a left-return arrow (`↩`) below a symmetric V-flap.
- **Brand idea:** **Control, not magic.**
- **One-liner:** CleanYourMail is a local-first IMAP cleanup product: a Python CLI and agent skill today, with a desktop app in development. It reads headers only, plans before action, and gives every move a way back.
- **Tagline (EN):** **Your inbox, minus the noise.**
- **Tagline (ES):** **Tu bandeja, sin el ruido.**

> The desktop app icon and app-first tokens are prepared for the planned app. Today the Python CLI and agent skill are the available interfaces.

The **Spectrum** colorway pairs a neutral carbon background (`#121316`) and warm off-white typography (`#F3F1EC`) with three semantic signal colors—**Orange (`#FFB38A`)**, **Yellow (`#FFE08A`)**, and **Mint (`#A8E6CF`)**—The mark uses the line-art envelope/arrow split; it takes only the color palette as inspiration and avoids diagonal esports slashes, condensed gaming display fonts or third-party trade dress.

---

## 2. Semantic color roles & contrast ratios

Rather than using orange, yellow, and mint at equal weight inside the logo, **Spectrum assigns each accent color to a distinct product truth**:

1. **Orange (`#FFB38A`) — Primary Action, Plan, CTA & Mark:**
   - Used for the Return Fold envelope and arrow, `Mail` in the dark-background wordmark, primary action buttons (`Review Plan`), and Step 1 (*Plan before action*).
   - Always use near-black (`#121316`) ink on orange fills (`10.67:1` AAA contrast).
2. **Mint (`#A8E6CF`) — Journal, Undo & Secondary Path:**
   - Used for append-only journal badges, undo step markers (Step 2: *Journal & undo moves*), and secondary structural accents.
   - Use for step markers, icons, and large headlines (`13.17:1` on `#121316`), **never** for small body copy on dark backgrounds.
3. **Yellow (`#FFE08A`) — Attention, Warnings & Irreversible Unsubscribe:**
   - Reserved for caution states and the separate, irreversible unsubscribe flow.
   - Use near-black (`#121316`) text on yellow badges (`14.40:1` AAA contrast).
4. **Neutral Foundation (`#121316`, `#2A2C31`, `#F3F1EC`, `#A19E96`):**
   - Carbon background `#121316`, elevated/border panel gray `#2A2C31`, warm off-white primary text `#F3F1EC`, and muted warm gray `#A19E96` for secondary copy.

## 5. Do / Don’t

### Do
- Keep the exact `CleanYourMail` casing and both taglines (*“Your inbox, minus the noise.”* / *“Tu bandeja, sin el ruido.”*).
- State clearly that CleanYourMail reads **headers only** (never bodies/attachments) and that **reversible applies to moves, while unsubscribe is separate and irreversible**.
- Use near-black `#121316` text on `#FFB38A` orange and `#FFE08A` yellow fills.
- Use `#7A5A00` (not `#FFB38A`) for the `Mail` wordmark accent on light `#F3F1EC` backgrounds so text contrast stays above `4.5:1` (`5.65:1`).

### Don’t
- Do not color the envelope flap, body, and arrow in three different colors inside the symbol or app icon.
- Do not copy diagonal esports stripes, skewed parallelogram boxes, or condensed gaming typography.
- Do not use `#A8E6CF` mint for small body text on `#121316` or `#2A2C31`.
- Do not add AI sparkles, gradients, glows, fake user counts, testimonials, benchmark claims, or fixed test counts.

## 7. Recommendation: Replace Green or Keep Spectrum as an Alternate?

**Recommendation: Adopt Spectrum (`brand/final-spectrum/`) as the primary skill-first identity-or offer it as the default dark theme while retaining Forest/Lime (`brand/final/`) as a classic CLI theme.**

Why **Spectrum** is exceptionally strong for a **skill-first** CleanYourMail:
1. **Built-in semantic hierarchy for a safety-critical GUI:** Unlike the monochrome green/teal palette (where both safe moves and warnings have to borrow outside colors or rely on subtle green shades), Spectrum gives the desktop app a native, high-contrast functional vocabulary right out of the brand palette:
   - **Orange (`#FFB38A`)** = *Plan / Review before action* (primary constructive action).
   - **Mint (`#A8E6CF`)** = *Journal / Undo* (the verified way back).
   - **Yellow (`#FFE08A`)** = *Irreversible Unsubscribe / Caution* (visually separating irreversible network actions from reversible IMAP folder moves).
2. **Superior desktop dock differentiation:** Most developer and productivity utilities on macOS/Windows docks cluster in blues, teals, or dark greens. A warm `#FFB38A` badge framed in `#121316` carbon (`app-icon.svg`) is immediately scannable at `32 px` and `64 px` on both dark and light docks while feeling like an industrial-grade local tool (akin to classic hardware instruments and diagnostic tools).
3. **Neutral carbon UI surfaces (`#121316` / `#2A2C31`):** Dense email header tables (sender, subject, date, size, flags) are easier to scan over neutral warm carbon (`#121316` with `#F3F1EC` warm paper text at `16.46:1`) than over tinted green backgrounds, while reducing visual fatigue during long inbox triage sessions.

# CleanYourMail — Forest Brand Identity & App Icon Guide

> **Primary skill-first identity:** [Spectrum](../final-spectrum/README.md) - pastel orange envelope, mint return arrow and the Spectrum palette. This package is the **Forest/Lime alternate**, kept for the classic CLI theme.

## 1. Brand idea & final decision

- **Name:** `CleanYourMail` (exact casing: capital **C**, **Y**, **M**; never rename, split with spaces, or publicly abbreviate).
- **Brand idea:** **Control, not magic.**
- **One-liner:** CleanYourMail is a local-first IMAP cleanup product: a Python CLI and agent skill today, with a desktop app in development. It reads headers only, plans before action, and gives every move a way back.
- **Tagline (EN):** **Your inbox, minus the noise.**
- **Tagline (ES):** **Tu bandeja, sin el ruido.**
- **Audience:** Non-technical people who want a calm visual app (the desktop app is in development), plus developers and coding agents who use the Python 3.11+ CLI engine. Today the CLI and agent skill are the available interfaces; the desktop app is the intended primary interface.

> The desktop app icon and app-first tokens are prepared for the planned app. Today the Python CLI and agent skill are the available interfaces.

### Three directions explored internally

1. **Orbit / Shielded Mail (Envelope + External Undo Loop):** Placed a circular counter-clockwise arrow around an envelope. Rejected because an external circular arrow around mail reads as a generic "refresh / sync inbox" button rather than reversible cleanup, and shrinking the envelope inside an outer ring degraded 16 px legibility.
2. **Plan Stack / Slotted Tray (Layered Header Rows + Checkmark):** Stacked horizontal bars representing message headers with a completion checkmark. Rejected because it lost immediate "mail" recognition, looked like a generic task manager on a desktop dock, and a checkmark implied automated approval rather than user review and a way back.
3. **Return Fold (Chosen):** An envelope whose right and bottom perimeter folds continuously into a bold left-return arrow (`↩`) below a classic symmetric V-flap. It unifies **mail** and **return / undo / control** into one continuous structural gesture with wide negative space, zero gradients, and no generic AI sparkle.

---

## 2. Three pillars & product truth

1. **Local by construction.** CleanYourMail runs locally today as a Python 3.11+ standard-library CLI and agent skill, with a desktop app in development. It is not a hosted SaaS. There is no CleanYourMail account, no telemetry, and no third-party API. It reads **headers only** (sender, subject, date, size, flags, and unsubscribe headers)—**say "headers only", never "no email data at all."** Message bodies and attachments are never fetched.
2. **Plan before action.** Every cleanup starts with an inspectable plan. Protected mail (personal, transactional, banking, security, medical, legal, travel, invoice, government, starred, answered, recent) is excluded from automatic actions, and there is **no permanent deletion**. Works with Gmail, Outlook/Microsoft 365, Yahoo, iCloud, Fastmail, Proton Bridge, and custom IMAP servers supporting `UIDPLUS` or `MOVE`.
3. **A way back.** Every move is recorded in an append-only local journal and verified by `Message-ID` (or `X-GM-MSGID`) before restore. **“Reversible” applies strictly to moves, not unsubscribe. Unsubscribe is a separate, irreversible flow.**

## 3. Logo construction

- **Symbol (`symbol.svg`, 512×512 viewBox):**
  - Dark canvas `#07100d` with a rounded-square lime tile (`x=40, y=40, width=432, height=432, rx=112`, fill `#b9f36a`).
  - Inside the tile, the Return Fold glyph uses a `30`-unit round-cap, round-join stroke (`#07100d`):
    - Envelope perimeter + bottom return shaft: `M116 276 V168 A28 28 0 0 1 144 140 H368 A28 28 0 0 1 396 168 V320 A28 28 0 0 1 368 348 H184`
    - Symmetric top V-flap: `M124 152 L240 238 Q256 250 272 238 L388 152`
    - Left-return arrowhead (`↩`): `M224 304 L178 348 L224 392`
  - The shortened left wall (`V168..276`) creates an intentional `72`-unit vertical and `62`-unit horizontal negative-space gate in front of the return arrowhead so the mark stays open and legible down to 16 px.
- **Favicon (`favicon.svg`, 64×64 viewBox):**
  - Redrawn on a 64-unit grid with the lime tile filling `x=2, y=2, width=60, height=60, rx=16` and a `4.5`-unit stroke (`#07100d`) so browser tabs and system trays at 16–32 px maximize icon area.
- **Wordmark (`wordmark.svg`, 604×96 viewBox):**
  - Outlined geometric sans-serif vector paths (`<path>`) with exact `CleanYourMail` capitalization (`CleanYour` in `#eef8ee`, `Mail` in `#b9f36a` on dark; `#102019` and `#3f721c` on light). Because the wordmark uses closed filled outlines, it has zero external font dependencies and scales uniformly at any resolution.

## 8. Do / Don’t

### Do
- Keep the exact `CleanYourMail` casing (capital **C**, **Y**, **M**) and exact tagline punctuation.
- Lead with the **local-first product** and the **Python CLI engine** today; present the desktop app as **in development**, not shipped.
- State clearly that CleanYourMail reads **headers only** (sender, subject, date, size, flags, unsubscribe headers), never bodies or attachments.
- State clearly that **reversible applies to moves**, while **unsubscribe is separate and irreversible**.
- Use `favicon.svg` at 16–32 px, `app-icon.svg` for desktop bundles/docks, `light.svg` on light surfaces, and `mono.svg` / `app-icon-mono.svg` for one-ink contexts.

### Don’t
- Do not reintroduce the old 4-point AI sparkle, gradients, glows, robots, shields, magic wands, or cloud icons.
- Do not stretch, rotate, skew, crop the tile, or place the dark-background wordmark (`#eef8ee` / `#b9f36a`) directly on a light background.
- Do not claim "reads no email data at all", "everything is reversible", or "deletes spam forever".
- Do not invent user counts, testimonials, speed benchmarks, or fixed test counts in banners or marketing cards.

All notable changes to CleanYourMail are documented here. The format is based on

## [1.3.0] - 2026-11-11

### Added

- Plan JSON now includes a `messages` preview for each actionable group: UID, mailbox, sender,
  display name, subject and date. The app can show exactly which messages will move without reading
  bodies. `plan --redact` clears these previews.
- `scripts/feedback.py`, an opt-in feedback and bug-report helper with a preview, explicit `--yes`
  and identifier redaction. It posts to the same Cloudflare Worker as the app and website and never
  runs automatically.
- `docs/FEEDBACK.md` and a short optional section in `SKILL.md` describing what may be sent.

## [1.2.2] - 2026-11-10

### Fixed

- A corrupt Microsoft token store is moved to `<file>.corrupt` and a fresh sign-in can be saved; the
  user no longer has to delete the file manually.
- The CLI warns when the token store is readable by other users on POSIX and tightens the file's
  Windows ACL with `icacls` after saving.
- The SMTP XOAUTH2 test now asserts STARTTLS happens before authentication.
- `test_connect_outlook_requires_client_id` is isolated from `PROJECT_CLIENT_ID`, so it cannot hit the
  network when the project ID is filled.

## [1.2.1] - 2026-11-10

### Security

- `secret` writes through a private temp file, rejects directory targets and removes the temp file on
  failure. A failed save no longer leaves the app password behind.
- The Microsoft token store refuses a refresh token whose saved account or client ID does not match
  the configured account or application.
- OAuth configurations require TLS for IMAP and SMTP; Microsoft OAuth requires
  `outlook.office365.com` / `smtp.office365.com`, so the bearer token is not sent to another host.

### Fixed

- `init` detects legacy Microsoft consumer domains (`hotmail.*`, `live.*`, `msn.*`) and infers
  `xoauth2` / `oauth = "microsoft"` for a Microsoft 365 host.
- Custom-domain Microsoft 365 configs get the `smtp.office365.com` default.
- `connect` reports corrupt pending/device files and unwritable token stores as configuration errors
  instead of tracebacks.

## [1.2.0] - 2026-11-10

### Added

- One-click Microsoft sign-in for Outlook.com and Microsoft 365: `python tools/mail.py connect
  outlook` uses the OAuth 2.0 device-code flow, stores only a refresh token and renews the access
  token automatically.
- `python tools/mail.py secret` saves an app password to a private local file without echoing it;
  `--clipboard` reads it from the clipboard and clears it.
- `init` detects Outlook addresses, writes `auth = "xoauth2"` and `oauth = "microsoft"`, and accepts
  `--secret-file` for the other providers.
- A guided Phase 0 in `SKILL.md`: provider choice, 2FA, app passwords, Microsoft sign-in and
  `doctor`, with one confirmation per step.
- `docs/MICROSOFT-OAUTH.md` with the one-time application registration and troubleshooting.

### Changed

- Outlook no longer asks for a manual access token. The refresh token lives in
  `~/.secrets/cleanyourmail-oauth.json` (override with `CYM_OAUTH_STORE`).
- SMTP now supports XOAUTH2 for Outlook `mailto:` unsubscribe requests.

### Fixed

- `init` detects custom-domain Microsoft 365 accounts and international `outlook.*` domains instead
  of falling back to `imap.example.com`.
- SMTP XOAUTH2 returns the string `smtplib` expects instead of bytes.

### Validated

- **Gmail / Google Workspace: pass.** Folders, archive, undo, rules and a synthetic one-click request
  were exercised on 2026-11-10.
- **Outlook.com / Microsoft 365: partial.** The device-code flow, token refresh and offline suite
  pass, but real IMAP is blocked by Microsoft's consent model. Microsoft 365 needs tenant
  administrator consent; Outlook.com personal needs a verified publisher. See `docs/VALIDATION.md`.

# Contributor Covenant Code of Conduct

## Our pledge

We as members, contributors, and leaders pledge to make participation in our community a
harassment-free experience for everyone, regardless of age, body size, visible or invisible
disability, ethnicity, sex characteristics, gender identity and expression, level of experience,
education, socio-economic status, nationality, personal appearance, race, religion, or sexual
identity and orientation.

We pledge to act and interact in ways that contribute to an open, welcoming, diverse, inclusive, and
healthy community.

## Our standards

Examples of behavior that contributes to a positive environment:

- Demonstrating empathy and kindness toward other people.
- Being respectful of differing opinions, viewpoints, and experiences.
- Giving and gracefully accepting constructive feedback.
- Accepting responsibility and apologizing to those affected by our mistakes, and learning from the
  experience.
- Focusing on what is best not just for us as individuals, but for the overall community.

Examples of unacceptable behavior:

- The use of sexualized language or imagery, and sexual attention or advances of any kind.
- Trolling, insulting or derogatory comments, and personal or political attacks.
- Public or private harassment.
- Publishing others' private information, such as a physical or email address, without their
  explicit permission.
- Other conduct which could reasonably be considered inappropriate in a professional setting.

## Enforcement responsibilities

Community leaders are responsible for clarifying and enforcing our standards of acceptable behavior
and will take appropriate and fair corrective action in response to any behavior that they deem
inappropriate, threatening, offensive, or harmful.

Community leaders have the right and responsibility to remove, edit, or reject comments, commits,
code, wiki edits, issues, and other contributions that are not aligned to this Code of Conduct, and
will communicate reasons for moderation decisions when appropriate.

## Scope

This Code of Conduct applies within all community spaces, and also applies when an individual is
officially representing the community in public spaces. Examples of representing our community
include using an official email address, posting via an official social media account, or acting as
an appointed representative at an online or offline event.

## Enforcement

Instances of abusive, harassing, or otherwise unacceptable behavior may be reported to the
maintainers through the contact in the repository profile. All complaints will be reviewed and
investigated promptly and fairly.

All community leaders are obligated to respect the privacy and security of the reporter of any
incident.

## Enforcement guidelines

Community leaders will follow these Community Impact Guidelines in determining the consequences for
any action they deem in violation of this Code of Conduct:

### 1. Correction

**Community Impact**: Use of inappropriate language or other behavior deemed unprofessional or
unwelcome in the community.

**Consequence**: A private, written warning from community leaders, providing clarity around the
nature of the violation and an explanation of why the behavior was inappropriate. A public apology
may be requested.

### 2. Warning

**Community Impact**: A violation through a single incident or series of actions.

**Consequence**: A warning with consequences for continued behavior. No interaction with the people
involved, including unsolicited interaction with those enforcing the Code of Conduct, for a specified
period of time. This includes avoiding interactions in community spaces as well as external channels
like social media. Violating these terms may lead to a temporary or permanent ban.

### 3. Temporary ban

**Community Impact**: A serious violation of community standards, including sustained inappropriate
behavior.

**Consequence**: A temporary ban from any sort of interaction or public communication with the
community for a specified period of time. No public or private interaction with the people involved,
including unsolicited interaction with those enforcing the Code of Conduct, is allowed during this
period. Violating these terms may lead to a permanent ban.

### 4. Permanent ban

**Community Impact**: Demonstrating a pattern of violation of community standards, including
sustained inappropriate behavior, harassment of an individual, or aggression toward or disparagement
of classes of individuals.

**Consequence**: A permanent ban from any sort of public interaction within the community.
